:::{#def-overall-agreement}
#### Overall agreement

Let:

- $A$ be the [event](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-event) that the agent assigns the positive [class](#def-class) to an observation drawn from a [population](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-population), with [complement](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-complement) $\neg A$.
- $R$ be the event that the reference assigns the positive class to the same observation, with complement $\neg R$.

The **overall agreement** of the agent and the reference on that population
is the [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) that they assign the same class to the observation:

$$p_o \eqdef \Prf{A \cap R} + \Prf{\neg A \cap \neg R}$$ {#eq-overall-agreement}

Source: @cohen1960coefficient.

:::
